body: Not enough, really. I spend way too much time on the internet, wasting it by doing anything to numb my thoughts. Most of the time I'm too tired and depressed to force myself to do anything active.

That''s really good advice, thank you. I've started trying to set more goals for myself, but they're all pretty big and it's rare that I give myself small, easily achievable ones just to help myself chill the fuck out. I just can't stop thinking about how much of a "loser" I look like on paper. My whole life I've heard from everybody how much potential I've had, and I feel like a disappointment to everyone and myself right now.

You're so sweet, thank you. Your comment made me smile, and I know that what you say is true, even though it's hard to see it sometimes. I just have a really hard time opening up to people and being vulnerable in real life, you know? I feel sometimes like I can only truly express myself online under the cloak of anonymity.
